items.sable_tournament:gyro.tooltip2: Automatic stabilization for helicopters and drones
items.sable_tournament:gyro.tooltip3: Redstone signal strength on top controls stabilization power
items.sable_tournament:six_way_spinner.tooltip: Generates torque in both directions around X, Y, Z axis
Redstone signal strength controls torque magnitude. Configurable via NBT parameters
items.sable_tournament:six_way_thruster.toolti: Provides thrust in all six directions (+/-X, +/-Y, +/-Z)

Configurable drag coefficient via NBT. Must be placed perpendicular to airflow
